text: {"reconstruction":3,"feasibility":2,"rationale":"The proposal gets the overall goal, subject, and body template right, but it omits the {blog} parameter and the separate blog tab step, wrongly treats the latest post as part of the GitHub profile, hardcodes recipient as a parameter instead of fixed hiring@example.com, ends with \"Send or save\" instead of Discard (never Send), and adds an unneeded Users filter step, so an automation would fail to find the blog and might send the email."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal, subject, and body template right, but it omits the {blog} parameter and the separate blog tab step, wrongly treats the latest post as part of the GitHub profile, hardcodes recipient as a parameter instead of fixed hiring@example.com, ends with "Send or save" instead of Discard (never Send), and adds an unneeded Users filter step, so an automation would fail to find the blog and might send the email.
